title: How Tej Chingtham built Northeast’s first incubator; The pilot-turned-entrepreneur who is building a wellness brand
summary: In a conversation with Shradha Sharma, Founder and CEO of YourStory and The Bharat Project, Prof Tej Chingtham,  CEO of Atal Incubation Centre - Sikkim Manipal University Technology Business Incubation Foundation, recalls what led him to look at the Northeast's startup ecosystem closely.
llm_summary: Prof. Tej Chingtham, who founded and now leads the Atal Incubation Centre at Sikkim Manipal University, explains how his early work as a pilot‑turned‑entrepreneur sparked a deep dive into the untapped startup potential of India’s Northeast.
